Name: crystalinerose Tilesheets
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[left][/left][size=3][center][b]🍊[/b][i] [/i][b]v1.3.1 Update: [/b][i]Added a new stairs-to-water tiles that work with grassy water borders, removed the mines water overlay (major cause of lag due to Cursors edit), and some minor fixes.[/i][i] [/i][b]🍊[/b]

This tilesheet mod will be used in future map mods I plan to make, but I decided to share them in case anyone else finds it useful. More to come - check out the 'Future Plans' section![/center][/size]
[size=2][img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Recolor Compatibility: [/b]Swatches matching [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿,[/b] [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]Earthy Recolor[/url]﻿, [/b]and[b] [/b][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley (1.6 Unofficial version)[/url]﻿[/b][b]. [/b]The flowers are matching with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20972]Simple Foliage[/url]﻿.[/b]
[*][b]Better Water 2 Compatibility: [/b]Water features in the tilesheets have recolors that match all 4 water color options in [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079]Better Water 2[/url]﻿.[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url]﻿ Auto-Matching: [/b]With CMCT, choosing Auto option will automatically match configs in this mod with other mods' configs.
[*][b]Seamless tiles: [/b]Some objects such as the flowering vines can be combined seamlessly with each other or the flower-less option.
[*][b]Vanilla mines tilesheet expansion: [/b]An expanded version of the standard and dangerous frost mines tilesheet, with new river border shapes, tide pools as hot springs, water features, and some decor items.[b] [/b]
[*][b]Seasonal items: [/b]Bridges, docks, and minecart tracks have seasonal pieces and there are some seasonal deco foliage.
[/list]
[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i]
[b]
[/b][list]
[*][size=2][b]Manual Recolor Selection: [/b]Manually select the tilesheet to match your recolor mod. Choose [i]"Off"[/i] option to auto detect the recolor mod you use.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]NOTICE: If you choose an option that matches A RECOLOR MOD YOU DO NOT HAVE INSTALLED, this mod will fall back to Vanilla colors. Readjust setting to [i]Off [/i]or the an installed recolor mod.[/b][/size]
[*][size=2][b]Vibrant Pastoral Fall Variant: [/b]Toggles between tilesheets that match orange or green fall option in VPR.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Better Water 2 Color: [/b]Toggles compatibility with Better Water 2 colors. Choose [i]"Off"[/i] option if you do not use Better Water 2. If you have CMCT installed, choose [i]"Auto" [/i]to automatically match this setting with your BW2 color settings.[/size]
[/list][/size]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/4FnJz60/instructions.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=2][b][i]For mod authors: [/i][/b]This mod is a resource for mapmakers. Do not include the files in this tilesheet mod in your mod's release folder but list it as a dependency. For a comprehensive list of usage permissions, please refer to the [i][b]Permissions[/b] [/i]tab above. Submitting images or links for your mods where you use my tilesheets are encouraged - feel free to ping me in the SDV Discord for this too! <3[/size]
[*][size=2][b][i]For mod users:[/i] [/b]Install this tilesheet if you have a mod that requires this as a dependency. Otherwise, this mod does nothing to your game.[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

[size=3]The following are a list of features contained in this mod:[/size]

[list=1]
[*][b]Island suspension bridge: [/b]Has seasonal edge pieces. Unlike the suspension bridge in Ginger Island,[b] these tiles[/b] [b]are not passable underneath; [/b]please apply it to connect cliffs or above impassable areas, like rivers. Same applies to the plank bridges if you decide to use them at higher ground. [b]Extendable[/b].
[*][b]Plank bridges: [/b]The vanilla plank bridges, but transparent so they could be placed anywhere and with seasonal edge pieces. [b]Extendable[/b].
[*][b]Dock tiles: [/b]A less dingy edit of the Vanilla Cindersap Forest lake dock tiles, now transparent so they can be mixed and matched, with a horizontal version, seasonal end pieces, center piece variants (holes/no holes), and various matching stilts/poles for decor. The stilts are separated so the dock surface can be used as a plank bridge. [b]Extendable.[/b]
[*][b](NEW!) Boardwalk tiles: [/b]A more vibrant recolor of the Beach boardwalk, made fully modular and extendable. Even the jankiest arrangements work and I'm very impressed with myself for that. [b]Extendable.[/b]
[*][b]Ladder: [/b]The new 1.6 ladder, but adjusted so they fit against the front-facing tall cliff tiles from spring_outdoorsTileSheet.png.
[*][b]River rocks and cattails: [/b]Exactly what it says on the tin. Place the bottom part on a Back layer with Water T property, then animate and place the top and middle (with the ripple effect) parts on the Buildings layer.
[*][b]Stepping stones: [/b]Seasonal transparent stepping stones you could place on dirt or grass terrain. Place on a Back layer, or Buildings with the Passable T property.
[*][b]River stepping stones: [/b]A version of the beach farm stepping stones, but made to match the dirt and dark dirt terrain. Animate similarly to those, and place on Buildings layer with Passable T property.
[*][b](NEW!) Seasonal minecart tracks: [/b]The Mines.png minecart tracks made transparent, recolored, and reworked slightly. Features seasonal textures that can be mixed and matched.
[*][b](NEW!) Assorted stones on grass tiles and tree trunks: [/b]What it says on the tin; I made textures in all grass shades that are not present in the vanilla tilesheet, and improved some of them.
[*][b](NEW!) Wooden outdoor stairs: [/b]The original upwards-facing stairs from spring_outdoorsTileSheet.png and the 1.6 downward facing stairs, now made for grass terrain (and Quarry dirt, for the ones lacking). Features seasonal endpieces.
[*][b](NEW!) Stairs-to-water grassy borders: [/b]What it says on the tin, too. Those border tiles that leads to bodies of water? Now with stairs, so you can make a natural-looking outdoor hot springs.
[*][b](NEW!) Forest canopy additional tiles: [/b]Also what it says on the tin. Seasonal and with more extra flowers.
[*][b]Natural water spout: [/b]Place on cliff faces to make a natural looking fountain. Animate like the fountain outside of the bath house exterior, and overlay with the mist effect on the Front layer. [b]Has Better Water 2 compatibility.[/b]
[*][b]Creeping vines: [/b]Has flowering and non-flowering options, and 2 versions for the 4-tile and 1.6's 2-tile height cliffs. Bottom part of the vines align with the bottom of the cliff tiles from spring_outdoorsTileSheet.png and spring_outdoorsTileSheet2.png.
[*][b]Outdoor lighting fixtures: [/b]Wall lanterns that can be placed on the 4-tile height cliffs and a rustic lantern post with [b]extendable [/b]post tiles. The lantern post has a small and large lantern option that are best used for short and long posts, respectively.
[*][b]Animated fireflies: [/b]Decorative fireflies (static position, but tiles can be animated). Pair with the Light map property and EditMap actions to create firefly swarms that spawn in your map at night, or all times if that's your jam.
[*][b]Magic warp runes: [/b]A set of 3 transparent runes that can be placed on any terrain tile, with matching glow overlay.
[*][b]Seasonal deco foliage and clutter: [/b]Exactly what it says on the tin. More decoration options!
[*][b]Dangerous frost mines tilesheet expansion: [/b]Meant to be used alongside Mines/mine_frost_dangerous.png.
[*][b]Mines tilesheet expansion: [/b]Meant to be used alongside Mines/mine.png.
[/list][size=3]
Update 1.2.0 adds a water overlay effect (replaces the one in [b]LooseSprites/Cursors.png[/b]) that matches with the water tiles in both the Mines/Frost Mines expansions and intended to be used for farm cave maps. This effect only applies if you set the config to [i]true, [/i]the map's [i]LocationName is "FarmCave"[/i], the water tiles have the [i]Water T[/i] property, and the map has the [i]indoorWater T[/i] property.

I have created a visual guide in the Media tab above, but decided to add some written instructions in the tilesheet itself for the seamless objects (i.e. suspension bridge, flowering vines). For these objects, the shorthands in the tilesheet mean:[/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=2][b]Front:[/b] Apply to the front-facing cliff tiles.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Dia.:[/b] Apply to the narrow diagonal cliff tiles (1x4, 1x2), left (L) or right (R) version.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Dia. Big:[/b] Apply to the large diagonal cliff tiles (2x4, 2x2).[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Slope:[/b] Apply to the 4x4 sloping cliff tiles.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Corner:[/b] Apply to the "edge" piece of the cliff tiles (1x4, 1x2).[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Center: [/b]The middle part of the object as a whole; [b]tiles marked as "center" can be used to extend the object[/b].[/size]
[*][size=2][b]H./V. Center: Center [/b]pieces that are only usable to extend the object horizontally (H.) or vertically (V).[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Arrows[/b] pointing to items on the tilesheet indicate which tile/object the shorthand applies to.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Amount of arrows[/b] pointing to items on the tilesheet indicate how many tiles/objects that the shorthand applies to.[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿.
[*](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip [i]"(CP) crystalinerose Tilesheets" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Configure as needed.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/dkyXBMw/future-plans.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Extras tilesheet focused on seasonal decor and clutter.
[*]Marshland tilesheet expansion.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]

[list=1]

[*][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/dugongkebalik?gameId=1303]dugongkebalik[/url]﻿ & [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Morghoula?gameId=1303]Morghoula [/url]﻿for [b]Simple Foliage[/b].
[/list]

[/b][/size]
